newsitem.title: USA: HBO & Co jumps after Q1 EPS beats estimates.
newsitem.headline: HBO & Co jumps after Q1 EPS beats estimates.

text.p: Shares of HBO & Co jumped in heavy trading on Wednesday after the health care information company posted stronger-than-expected first quarter earnings.

Shares rose 3-3/8 to 53 early in the session. The Atlanta-based company earlier reported earnings per share of $0.38. That was a nickel more than Wall Street's forecast of $0.33 a share, according to the First Call consensus of analysts' estimates.
In the first quarter of 1996, HBO & Co earned $0.24.
HBO said it had record earnings per share and cash flow from operations in the first quarter.
It closed the period with cash and investments totaling over $219 million and a decline in accounts receivable and days' sales outstanding.
